title: Ticket 1.62.1 — move emergency food ordering into primary-admin system settings
notes: Moves emergency-order-window controls from the food calendar to System Settings, directly below Manual Receipt Registration, as a nested form. The control and state endpoint are primary-admin-only in both UI and server authorization; support managers cannot view, grant, inspect, or revoke the window. Includes the 1.62 selected-employee food report and ticket service-group access separation. No schema migration or online dependency.
